summary: the IP transmit rows of packet_hosttest.c with seven faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/network/ip/ip.c, each of which must fail its row with status 1; the test includes ip.c by a path relative to itself, so the build copies the test and rach2/sys under the work directory

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/rach2 ${WORK}/b/tests/host; cp -R rach2/sys ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/network/ip/ip.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/network/ip/ip.c; cp tests/host/packet_hosttest.c ${WORK}/b/tests/host/; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat ${WORK}/b/tests/host/packet_hosttest.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/lib/kstring.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/lib/kctypes.c -o ${WORK}/packet_hosttest

faults.name: log-per-drop
faults.summary: a log line for every datagram the full loopback ring refuses

lines: one line records the refusals, not one a datagram
a datagram past a full loopback ring is refused with -ENOBUFS

faults.name: overwrite
faults.summary: a refused datagram copied over the oldest one queued

lines: the drain delivers the datagrams the ring took, in the order sent, and none it refused

faults.name: first-card
faults.summary: a subnet broadcast sent by the first card whatever its subnet

lines: the second card's subnet broadcast leaves by that card

faults.name: limited-scan
faults.summary: the limited broadcast given to a card whose subnet's broadcast it equals

lines: the limited broadcast leaves by the first card beside a card masked /1

faults.name: idle-ticks
faults.summary: a tick on an idle machine counted as one datagram left for the timer whatever the ring holds

lines: an empty ring leaves nothing for the timer
